scope: User-requested implementation-plan conformance audit and corrective implementation

lint.disposition: Remaining lint debt; not a pass; no new suppression added

limitedExportBuild.scope: Ranking, dashboard, all eight ranking CSV endpoints, sitemap index and eight nonempty XML chunks; detail paths excluded; debug output is not a deployable full export

fullExport.disposition: Stopped before completion to preserve remaining disk space. Final source full export is unverified.

standaloneHttp.originContract: Next Request.url origin and port, including native loopback hostname normalization; not raw Host-header forwarding

visualReview.disposition: Main structure conforms semantically to the implementation plan; follow-up verdict resolves F1-F4 only. Not user acceptance or whole-surface approval.

handoff.purpose: Final production preview for the user, not an additional full design review

designHookIgnoreScope: Follow-up hook triage only: four font-alias values across five locations, restricted to styles.css, scoreboard.css and desktop-shell.css in .impeccable/logo-review. Intentional comparison prototypes; no product file or whole-rule suppression.
